subject: Adjusting the error threshold for calc_errorlod

messages.author: 69f7d832a0cbc260
messages.subject: Adjusting the error threshold for calc_errorlod
parts:
Hi,

I am in the process of cleaning some DO data and was just wondering whether there is a way that I can alter the genotyping error LOD score threshold (defaults to 2) in calc_errorlod()?

Thanks in advance,

Harry

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Adjusting the error threshold for calc_errorlod
parts:
I don’t understand what you mean. There is no threshold used by calc_errorlod(). The results are dependent on the error_prob argument in calc_genoprob(), but I think not dramatically so.

karl

Sorry if I didn't phrase my question clearly.

In your 2019 paper (https://www.g3journal.org/content/early/2019/03/15/g3.119.400165.article-info?versioned=true), you mention that genotyping errors are determined at a LOD error score of 2. I was wondering if there is a way of adjusting this 'threshold' within the calc_errorlod() function to be more strict on calling errors. For example, calling an errors for markers with LOD error scores of 1 instead?

Hope that makes more sense, sorry about the confusion.
